name: Night Watch

verse.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

lines: Minister Theophilus Sunday leads worshippers on day two of Tarry Abuja 2026 to deepen spiritual growth and gospel outreach.
Gospel artist Ohemaa Mercy has released a live worship video featuring powerful moments from her annual Tehilla Experience gathering.
The Ghana Revenue Authority clarified that the new digital VAT system will not impose additional taxes on existing compliant platforms.
A fire at the Mallam GRIDCo substation caused temporary power outages affecting homes, businesses, and schools across parts of Accra.
Veteran sports administrator Nana Fitz has urged officials not to rush the appointment of the next Black Stars head coach.
prayers: Lord, sustain families, businesses, and students in Accra affected by recent power disruptions with swift restoration and peace.
Heavenly Father, grant wisdom to sports authorities as they seek the right leadership for the national team.
Father, let worship and prayer draw hearts closer to You, bringing spiritual renewal across our homes and communities.
